purpose: Verify that submission proceeds when mandatory eligibility criteria are satisfied.
preconditions: Student is logged in. Scholarship scheme has an open application window. Student meets all machine-checkable mandatory criteria for the active catalogue version.
action_or_input: Student completes and submits the application.
expected_result: Application is accepted and state changes to Submitted.

purpose: Verify that submission is blocked when mandatory eligibility criteria are not satisfied and no exception applies.
preconditions: Student is logged in. Scholarship scheme has an open application window. Student fails at least one machine-checkable mandatory criterion. No reviewable exception is configured or approved.
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit the application.
expected_result: Submission is blocked and the system identifies the unsatisfied criteria.

purpose: Verify that a duplicate active/submitted application is rejected when the scheme does not permit duplicates.
preconditions: Student has an existing active or submitted application for Scholarship X in Cycle Y. The scheme does not explicitly permit duplicates.
action_or_input: Student attempts to create a new application for Scholarship X in Cycle Y.
expected_result: The duplicate application is rejected.

purpose: Verify that a duplicate application is allowed when the scheme explicitly permits it.
preconditions: Student has an existing active or submitted application for Scholarship X in Cycle Y. The scheme configuration explicitly permits duplicates.
action_or_input: Student creates a new application for Scholarship X in Cycle Y.
expected_result: The duplicate application is accepted and created.

purpose: Verify that a previously uploaded document can be reused when valid and matching.
preconditions: Student has a previously uploaded document that belongs to them, is still valid, and satisfies the document type/evidence requirement of the selected scheme.
action_or_input: Student selects the previously uploaded document during application drafting.
expected_result: The system offers and accepts the valid matching document for reuse.

purpose: Verify that an invalid or mismatched document cannot be reused.
preconditions: Student has a previously uploaded document that is expired, does not belong to them, or does not satisfy the document type/evidence requirement of the selected scheme.
action_or_input: Student attempts to select the invalid/mismatched document for reuse.
expected_result: The system does not offer the document for reuse and requires a new upload.

purpose: Verify that a complete application is accepted for submission.
preconditions: All mandatory fields and required documents for the applicable scheme version are present in the draft.
action_or_input: Student submits the application.
expected_result: Submission is accepted and the application state changes to Submitted.

purpose: Verify that an incomplete application is blocked from submission.
preconditions: At least one mandatory field or required document for the applicable scheme version is missing from the draft.
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit the application.
expected_result: Submission is blocked and the system identifies the missing items.

purpose: Verify that an authorized SPACS Assistant or Convener can access applications for review.
preconditions: User is logged in with an assigned/authorized SPACS Assistant or Convener role.
action_or_input: User opens a scholarship application review record.
expected_result: Access is granted to the application and supporting evidence.

purpose: Verify that an unauthorized user is denied access to application review.
preconditions: User is logged in but does not have an assigned/authorized SPACS Assistant or Convener role.
action_or_input: User attempts to open a scholarship application review record.
expected_result: Access is denied.

purpose: Verify that an Assistant can record a verification concern and route it to the Convener.
preconditions: Application is in Submitted state and assigned to an SPACS Assistant. Assistant identifies suspected ineligibility or invalid evidence.
action_or_input: Assistant records a verification concern.
expected_result: The concern is recorded and the application is routed to the SPACS Convener for final decision.

purpose: Verify that an Assistant cannot make the final scholarship approval/rejection decision.
preconditions: Application is verified and assigned to an SPACS Assistant.
action_or_input: Assistant attempts to execute a final approval or rejection action.
expected_result: The system denies the action as the Assistant lacks final decision authority.

purpose: Verify that a recoverable application draft is preserved on a recoverable timeout or system error.
preconditions: Student is actively drafting an application and has entered data.
action_or_input: A recoverable timeout or system error occurs before explicit save.
expected_result: The entered data is persisted as a draft and the student can resume later.

purpose: Verify that notifications are issued for significant lifecycle events.
preconditions: Application is in a state where a significant lifecycle event (e.g., submission, correction request) occurs.
action_or_input: The lifecycle event is triggered.
expected_result: Configured e-mail and in-dashboard notifications are issued to the affected student and/or responsible role.

purpose: Verify that a student can withdraw their application before a final decision.
preconditions: Application is in a designated withdrawable state (e.g., Draft, Submitted before verification is locked). No final decision has been made.
action_or_input: Student requests withdrawal of their application.
expected_result: Application state is set to Withdrawn, pending tasks are closed, and the action is logged.

purpose: Verify that a student cannot withdraw their application after a final decision.
preconditions: Application has reached a final decision state (Approved or Rejected).
action_or_input: Student requests withdrawal of their application.
expected_result: The withdrawal request is denied.

purpose: Verify that the owning student can modify their application.
preconditions: Application is in an editable state (e.g., Draft, Correction Required). User is the owning student.
action_or_input: Owning student modifies and resubmits the application.
expected_result: Modification is accepted and application is revalidated.

purpose: Verify that a non-owner is denied modification of an application via the student interface.
preconditions: Application is in an editable state. User is not the owning student.
action_or_input: Non-owner user attempts to modify the application via the student interface.
expected_result: The modification request is denied.

purpose: Verify that a correction/resubmission invalidates previous verification/routing information.
preconditions: Application was previously verified and routed. Student submits a correction/resubmission that materially modifies the application.
action_or_input: Student resubmits the application after correction.
expected_result: Previous verification/routing information is invalidated and the application returns to the appropriate verification state with fresh validation.

purpose: Verify that a student can export their own application.
preconditions: User is logged in as a student and owns a submitted application.
action_or_input: Student requests to download/print their own application.
expected_result: Access is granted and the application is exported.

purpose: Verify that a student is denied export of another student's application.
preconditions: User is logged in as a student. Target application belongs to a different student.
action_or_input: Student attempts to download/print the other student's application.
expected_result: Access is denied.

purpose: Verify that SLA reminders or escalations are triggered when task age reaches the threshold.
preconditions: A verification or decision task is pending. The configured SLA threshold time has elapsed.
action_or_input: System evaluates task age against the configured threshold.
expected_result: The configured reminder or escalation notification is issued to the configured recipient(s).

purpose: Verify that applications use the published/active catalogue-policy version effective for the cycle.
preconditions: A new catalogue version is published with a new effective date. A new application cycle begins.
action_or_input: Student creates and submits an application in the new cycle.
expected_result: The application is evaluated against the newly active catalogue-policy version, and historical records retain the version used at the time.

purpose: Verify that catalogue publication is blocked without required policy approval metadata.
preconditions: SPACS Convener attempts to publish a policy-affecting catalogue version. The version lacks the required approval reference or equivalent evidence.
action_or_input: Convener attempts to publish/activate the catalogue version.
expected_result: Publication is blocked by the system.

purpose: Verify that document authenticity is recorded by an authorized reviewer.
preconditions: Application document is uploaded. An authorized reviewer or explicit external verification service is available.
action_or_input: Authorized reviewer examines the document and records substantive correctness/authenticity.
expected_result: The system records the authenticity verification by the authorized reviewer.

purpose: Verify that document upload alone is not treated as authenticated evidence.
preconditions: Student uploads a document. No authorized reviewer or external verification service has reviewed it.
action_or_input: System processes the uploaded document.
expected_result: The system validates presence/type/dates but does not treat the upload alone as authenticated evidence.

purpose: Verify that a renewal undergoes fresh verification and decision.
preconditions: Scholarship is renewable. Student submits a renewal application within the configured renewal window.
action_or_input: Student submits the renewal application.
expected_result: The renewal is routed through fresh verification and decision processing according to the active scheme policy.

purpose: Verify that the SPACS Convener can make the final scholarship approval.
preconditions: Application is verified and routed to the SPACS Convener.
action_or_input: SPACS Convener executes the final approval action.
expected_result: The final approval is accepted and recorded.

purpose: Verify that the SPACS Assistant cannot make the final scholarship approval.
preconditions: Application is verified. User is logged in as SPACS Assistant.
action_or_input: SPACS Assistant attempts to execute the final approval action.
expected_result: The system denies the action as the Assistant is not the authorized decision role.

purpose: Verify that award evaluation and approval follow the committee/authority defined by the active award policy.
preconditions: An award cycle is active. The active award policy defines a specific committee (e.g., Director's Gold Medal Committee).
action_or_input: Award candidates are evaluated and finalized.
expected_result: Tasks are routed and decisions are accepted according to the configured policy authority, not solely the SPACS Convener.

purpose: Verify that candidate generation and evaluation use the award criteria version effective for the cycle.
preconditions: Award criteria have been versioned. A specific award cycle is active.
action_or_input: System generates candidates and evaluates them for the active cycle.
expected_result: The system uses and retains the award criteria version effective for that specific award cycle.

purpose: Verify that significant actions are audit logged and protected from ordinary modification.
preconditions: A significant SPACS action (e.g., decision, catalogue publication) occurs. Ordinary user and authorized audit personnel exist.
action_or_input: Action completes. Ordinary user attempts to modify the audit record. Authorized personnel attempts to view it.
expected_result: Audit event is appended and time-stamped. Ordinary user modification is denied. Authorized personnel view is granted.

purpose: Verify that role reassignment routes pending tasks but preserves historical actor identity.
preconditions: User A (SPACS Assistant) has completed verification on an application and has pending tasks. User A's role is reassigned to User B.
action_or_input: System processes the role reassignment.
expected_result: Pending tasks route to User B. Previously completed actions by User A retain User A's historical actor identity in the audit trail.

purpose: Verify that an award cycle obtains candidates using the method configured by the active award policy.
preconditions: Award cycle is opened. The active award policy configures candidate source as system-generated eligible pool (not student-applied).
action_or_input: System initiates candidate creation for the award cycle.
expected_result: The system generates the eligible pool from academic records according to the configured method, rather than expecting student applications.
